_comment: Baked daiyooo-vfx effects for monster moves (client/monster_vfx.gd; display only, the rules never read this). Key = '<event>/<id>': 'area_placed/<area id>' plays at the ground area the rules just marked (scaled by the area radius / ref_radius, started at 'seek' seconds so the clip's own burst lands when the area detonates), 'attack_started/<move id>' plays on the attacker when the move starts and 'attack_active/<move id>' when its blow lands (follow = stays on it, ahead = metres along its facing, face = turned along its facing), 'projectile_fired/<projectile id>' plays at the shot's release point turned along its flight (face; forward/lift = metres to move the asset origin along the flight / up, for a bundle whose own flight starts off its origin), 'wave_arrived/<enemy type>' plays under every monster of the wave that brings that type (boss_scale for the bosses, scale for the rest). vfx = the bundle folder under res://art/vfx/monster/ (effect.tscn + effect.glb + recipe.json from the daiyooo-vfx MCP). speed = playback rate. The Mummy High Wizard's kit (combat-designer 2026-11-18): golden bolt, curse circle, starfall marks, sandstorm, and the summoning circles its escorts rise from.
_orc_warlock: Orc Warlock (tech-artist 2026-11-21, Boss: spectacular, grand, violent L3 boss effects of its own): four daiyooo bundles under art/vfx/monster/orc_warlock/ in ember orange / fire gold with a touch of purple magic. cleave = a heavy ember slash arc with sparks, turned along its facing (face) where the blow lands (attack_active); skyfall = a meteor from the sky (falling, as the sky presets) that crashes in front of it with a shockwave, fire, debris and embers: started with the move and following it through the leap, sped so its 1.3 s impact lands on the 1.0 s blow; cataclysm = the Breaker Slam: radiating glowing cracks, flying rock slabs, dust, a shock wall (no flat ground ring) where the sword hits; bulwark = a held ember aura round the guard and a shield-bash flash with iron and ember sparks at 0.33 s (its blow). The violence looks on top are in vfx.json (violence.skills monster/orc_warlock_*).
